items.name: 천지를 빚은 태초의 손 · 마고
items.description: 산과 강을 빚었다는 마고가 두 손에 작은 산하를 품고 한강을 바라봐요.
items.action: Hands held forward together, empty upward-facing palms at a stable location. Keep face and torso rigid while the fingers open gently and both hands draw together then unfold; flowing Korean hanbok sleeves and long white hair trail LEFT in the water. Eight physical poses: 4 gentle floating/swimming poses; 4 prepare, open palms, relax and return. No miniature mountain or star baked into the sprite: a separate game effect will create it.

items.name: 서울의 수호신 · 해태
items.description: 옳고 그름을 살피는 해태가 서울의 밤과 물길을 든든하게 지켜요.
items.action: An underwater forward-swimming Korean blue/gold haetae. Body is HORIZONTAL, buoyant, belly clear of any ground. Forelegs sweep forward then backward as slow swimming paddles; hind legs extend backward behind hips then tuck slightly. Mane and tail flow left. Never standing, walking, running or contacting a floor. Four connected paddling poses; same head, chest and scale.

items.name: 천년구미호
items.description: 천 년의 달빛을 아홉 꼬리에 모은 구미호가 여우구슬을 품고 나타나요.
items.action: An underwater forward-swimming nine-tailed white fox. Horizontal streamlined body, forepaws paddle water with small alternating strokes, hind paws stretch back and relax, nine long tails trail LEFT in a coherent slow traveling wave. No stepping on ground, standing or running. Keep exactly nine tails, face and torso stable; four continuous physical swim poses.

items.name: 철을 먹고 자라난 재앙 · 불가사리
items.description: 쇠를 먹을수록 단단해진다는 전설의 짐승이에요. 바다의 별 불가사리와는 다른 존재예요.
items.action: An underwater forward-swimming armored Korean bulgasari beast. Horizontal buoyant torso, forelegs make connected swimming paddle strokes, hind legs extend backward then gently flex, long trunk points to SCREEN RIGHT and stays stable, tail streams LEFT. No walking, stomping, standing or bottom contact. Keep armored chest/head fixed; four connected aquatic propulsion poses.

items.name: 붉은 함성의 화신 · 붉은악마
items.description: 붉은 응원의 불꽃과 북소리가 모여 탄생한 거대한 정령이에요. 북을 두드릴 때마다 함성의 물결이 퍼져요.
items.action: Korean red cheering fire spirit holding its ONE round taegeuk drum. Lock the FACE, CHEST AND DRUM TOGETHER at exactly the same positions and scale in ALL eight cells. Never turn torso, change face perspective, shrink/enlarge drum, crouch, bob or rotate. The mallet arm alone articulates. Flames remain one compact attached mass, only small outer tips flutter. Frames0-3 gentle arm/flame movement; frame4 mallet raised moderately, frame5 mallet contacts drum with a small wrist movement, frame6 releases contact, frame7 same neutral arm position as frame0. No dramatic pose or separate second drum. No detached particles, halos, sparks or effects.
